description: Fugas de agua potable en la red provincial is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Drinking water leaks in the provincial network Water leaks in the drinking water supply network. Data provided by the Network Inspection Service of the Diputación de Castellón. The dataset provides information on the location of the leak and the causes following the relevant inspection. Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water leaks in the provincial network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. Its keywords include calidad ambiental, provincia de Castellón, geolocalizado, aguas. The listing shows 5 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
